Howmet Fastening Systems is looking for a Director of Operations to provide overall leadership to the fastener installation tooling manufacturing facility located in Kingston, NY
Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM), headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. Our primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts and forged wheels. With $7.4 Billion in revenue in 2024, our products play a crucial role in enabling fuel efficiency and lightweighting, contributing to our customers’ success and making a positive impact on the world. To learn more about the way Howmet Aerospace Inc. is advancing the sustainability of our customers, markets, and communities where we operate, review the 2024 Environmental Social and Governance report at  www.howmet.com/esg-report . Follow:  LinkedIn ,  Twitter ,  Instagram ,  Facebook , and  YouTube .
Born from many well-known and long-standing brands, Howmet Fastening Systems, headquartered in Torrance, California, is the premier designer and manufacturer of aerospace and industrial fasteners, latches, fluid fittings and installation tools. Our products are used nose to tail on commercial and military aircraft, as well as on jet engines, industrial gas turbines, automobiles, commercial transportation vehicles, wind turbines, solar power systems, and construction and industrial equipment.
Specific Duties
- Develops annual revenue and manufacturing plan in consultation with other senior-level unit leaders to ensure proper deployment of resources to achieve required levels of production and to meet customer delivery requirements.

- Provides positive leadership to subordinate managers and to all assigned employees.   Ensures open communications and responds to employee concerns in an appropriate manner.   Seeks to improve the knowledge, skill and ability of people.   Deals proactively with substandard performance.

- Ensures full compliance with EHS standards, policies, procedures and processes as they apply to area of accountability.   Confirms that incidents are thoroughly investigated and that root causes are identified and remedied on a systematic basis.   Fosters a safe and healthy work environment for all employees.

- Interfaces directly with key customers, in concert with Sales & Marketing Management and Account Managers to resolve problems related to delivery, quality and other issues.   Strives to address customer concerns in a responsive, professional manner while protecting the interests of the Company.

- Coordinates activities with other departments such as Sales & Marketing, Engineering/R&D, Purchasing, Accounting, Information Systems, and Human Resources.   Secures required resources and consultative support from staff units as required.

- Continually improves the performance of the Manufacturing organization through the application of CI principles to drive down costs and improve location profitability.   This includes the application of specific techniques such as kaizen rapid improvement events and the development of a Continuous Improvement mindset within the Manufacturing organization.

- Participates with Purchasing personnel to develop partnerships with vendors which produce mutually beneficial arrangements related to purchased item quality and pricing. Ensures that concerns and issues related to purchased resources are addressed and resolved in a timely manner.

- Interacts positively and effectively with personnel, both internal and external to the organization. This may include factory floor personnel, management at various levels throughout the Company and governmental regulators.  Participates in external activities to secure a positive community image of the Company.

- Provides technical manufacturing assistance to other components of the organization, including Company units both external and internal to HFS.

- Analyzes and directs the preparation of Capital Appropriation Requests to secure required capital equipment for projects meeting or exceeding capital return targets.

- Directs the activities of assigned human resources and makes recommendations on hiring, disciplinary actions, promotions, demotions, terminations and salary adjustments.

- Maintains full compliance with Company policies and procedures and conducts all activities in accordance with the Company Guide to Business Conduct.

- Perform other duties as assigned

Benefits/Salary:
- The position includes competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance (medical, dental, vision), excellent 401k matching program, paid holidays and vacation.

-   The annual salary range for this position is $220,000 – $240,000

Join our Howmet Fastening Team!   Howmet Aerospace has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Manager, Continuous Improvement in our Brea, CA location.
This role will directly manage a team of 2–3 Continuous Improvement Engineers and will be accountable for driving lean‑manufacturing excellence, safety, quality, delivery, and cost across all production lines.
You will lead continuous improvement efforts and guide a team in applying Howmet Business System (HBS) methods to improve throughput, productivity, cost efficiency, and delivery performance.
Key Responsibilities:
Team Leadership:
- Directly supervise and mentor a cross‑functional improvement team.
- Set quarterly goals, conduct performance reviews, and develop career paths.
- Foster a high‑performance culture of accountability and ownership

Lean Manufacturing Execution:
- Own the implementation of Kaizen, Value‑Stream Mapping, 5S, Standard Work, and    SMED across all lines.
- Lead continuous improvement projects that target 10–15   % waste reduction per year.
- Champion the use of digital tools (e.g., Minitab, LeanKit) for real‑time KPI tracking.

Strategic Planning:
- Translate plant and corporate objectives into measurable improvement roadmaps.
- Align improvement initiatives with safety, quality, and cost targets.
- Provide quarterly status reports to senior leadership.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration:
- Partner with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance to identify bottlenecks.
- Facilitate cross‑functional improvement workshops and Kaizen events.
- Act as the primary liaison for external Lean consultants and auditors

Performance Measurement:
- Design, maintain, and refine dashboards for SQDC metrics.
- Own the root‑cause process (A3, 8D, 5‑Whys) and ensure corrective actions are closed on time.
- Conduct variance programs for Lean tools and Six‑Sigma methodologies.
Mentor leaders and frontline teams to embed a culture of continuous improvement.
- Conduct “train‑the‑trainer” sessions to scale knowledge.

Safety & Compliance:
- Integrate safety metrics into all improvement projects.
- Ensure all Lean initiatives comply with OSHA, EPA, and company safety standards.
- Promote a proactive safety culture through regular audits and feedback loops.

jobs.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications:

- Minimum 10 years of experience in manufacturing environments in areas such as: Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, or Operational Excellence

- Minimum of 7 years in leadership roles in Operations or Continuous Improvement

- Previous experience in an aerospace, automotive or other manufacturing environment requiring significant lean strategies to maintain wins and propel the organizations’ success through Continuous Improvement

- Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution

- Must be willing to travel up to 50% of the time, including domestic and international travel

- Strong working knowledge and understanding of Continuous Process Improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma.

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

- This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) which requires U.S. person status. ITAR defines U.S. person as an U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e. 'Green Card Holder'), Political Asylee, or Refugee

- Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree and Master's Degree from an accredited institution in Engineering or Supply Chain field of study highly desired

- Project Management certification or earned certificate

- Experience developing operations leadership development programs in a manufacturing environment

- Demonstrated experience in manufacturing improvement techniques, including hoshin, flow principles, Jidoka, Kanban, 5S, and “plan for every part” (PFEP).

- Strong skills in value stream mapping and associated improvement methodologies.

- Understanding of pillars of Toyota production system (JIT, Jidoka).

- Experience evaluating TAKT time vs. cycle time, determining work area constraints (i.e. cycle time constraint, periodic work constraints, downtime constraints).

- Experience on the shop floor, working with employees, and enhancing manufacturing processes.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills require the ability to resolve conflicting interests and obtain cooperation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: able to develop and use structured approaches to identify root causes and recommend resolutions.

- Demonstrated experience in project leadership and project management skills, with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines.
Howmet Engines seeks an experienced professional to join our team!  The Continuous Improvement Director at Howmet Aerospace is responsible for driving the implementation and sustained use of Lean principles, enhancing operational efficiency and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across the business segment   This role serves as a teacher, coach and mentor, working closely with employees at all levels to build long-term adoption of CI practices.   The Continuous Improvement Director partners with Senior Leadership to align improvement initiatives with business objectives, ensuring measurable impact on productivity, capacity and overall business segment performance.

Primary Responsibilities

- Lead the continued development and enhancement of the Howmet Business System journey, including accelerating the Lean Execution Systems Assessment process and progress, working with plant teams on gap closure plans in support of advancing the CI culture across the business segment.

- Facilitate the Howmet Business System “HBS” journey best practice sharing within the location and across teams through a sustainable electronic system that allows users to search for common issues or problems.

- Lead OEE improvement actions deep dive with leaders and provide avenues for best practice sharing.

- Lead Howmet Business System implementation of continuous improvement initiatives and drive waste reductions utilizing Lean principles (JIT, Autonomation, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, 5S, Standard Work, Line/Cell Design, Single Piece Flow, Material Flow, Visual Management, SMED, TPM, Root Cause Problem Solving, etc.)

- Facilitate Hoshins, Kaizens, problem solving, and rapid improvement process events with internal personnel at all levels of the organization, consultants, customers, and suppliers as needed. This includes providing support to sustain all follow-throughs required to sustain the improvements initiated during those events, especially those concentrated on local improvement.

- Understand and analyze Profit and Loss (P&L) statements to identify opportunities for cost reduction, revenue enhancement, and margin improvement. Lead and collaborate with cross functional internal teams focused on shop floor factory improvements, which could include CAPEX.

- Assist team leaders in team skill and knowledge development to support meeting management goals, project management, improvements, results measurements, problem solving and related team skills.

- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress and measure the impact of improvement initiatives.

- Drive change management efforts to ensure successful implementation and sustainability of process improvements.

- Identify and share best practices, lessons learned, and success stories to promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the organization.

- Provide coaching and mentorship to team members across the organization to drive the Continuous Improvement mindset.

- May participate or lead other targeted initiatives or kaizens as directed by the BU, as defined by the Segment Vice President.

- Role may support other sites’ continuous improvement activities, as needed (e.g., training, project-based work, best practice support, etc.)

Howmet Fastening Systems (HFS) is seeking a Continuous Improvement Manager in our Torrance, California location. HFS is a business unit of Howmet Aerospace, headquartered in Torrance, California.  We hold the number one global position in aerospace fastening systems, and we’re the North American leader in commercial transportation fasteners. Our high-tech, multi-material fastening systems are found nose to tail on aircraft and aerospace engines. Our products are also critical components of industrial gas turbines, automobiles, commercial transportation vehicles, and construction and industrial equipment.
Summary:
Responsible for managing lean manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives at Howmet Fastening System’s (HFS). This role drives and leads a wide range of activities that are designed to improve operations efficiency, productivity, and on-time delivery while minimizing cost and waste.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
- Define activities that require engineered solutions resulting in reduced waste, improved quality, improved throughput, increased machine/person ratio, improved safety, and improved business unit DVP%.
- Lead and collaborate with cross functional internal teams focused on shop floor factory improvements, which could include CAPEX.
- Standardize process and document for repeatability, train and certify operators.
- Understand and analyze Profit and Loss (P&L) statements to identify opportunities for cost reduction, revenue enhancement, and margin improvement.
- Analyze existing processes and identify areas for improvement through data-driven methods such as Lean Six Sigma principles, root cause analysis, and statistical tools.
- Act as internal consultant and catalyst to assist plant leadership, individuals, and teams in the application of continuous improvement principles and techniques to improve operations.
- Drive consistent, uniform approaches for visual controls and productivity measurements to be utilized throughout production teams and the factory.
- Facilitate successful Kaizen and rapid improvement process events with employees, customers and suppliers, with a major emphasis on locally focused improvement. Provide support for all follow-throughs required to sustain the improvements during the events.
- Instruct and train others in continuous process improvements, including the use of various problem solving and productivity techniques such as process mapping and cost time management.
- Provide formal training on lean manufacturing and continuous improvement concepts, principles, and practices. Utilize a learn-by-doing approach, supplementing classroom work with hands-on training
- Assist team leaders in team skill and knowledge development to support meeting management goals, project management, improvements, results measurements, problem solving and related team skills.
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress and measure the impact of improvement initiatives.
- Role may support other HFS sites’ continuous improvement activities, as needed (e.g., training, project-based work, best practice support, etc.)
- Drive change management efforts to ensure successful implementation and sustainability of process improvements.
- Identify and share best practices, lessons learned, and success stories to promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the organization.
- Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies related to continuous improvement methodologies.

jobs.title: Operations Manager Plant 10
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications:

- HS Degree or GED and a minimum of 7 years in manufacturing with 5 years in leadership OR 3 years in leadership with minimum 1 year of Howmet leadership experience as a leader of other leaders in operations in a castings plant.

- ​Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor's Degree

- Experience in the investment casting industry a plus.

- Strong leadership skills that create an engaged employee environment.

- Able to drive improvement through the implementation of the lean manufacturing principles, total quality practices, six sigma.

- A strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes.

- Strong analytical, problem solving, communication, interpersonal, organizational and negotiation skills.

- Strong financial literacy

- Experience with tooling, molds and dies relating to the Investment Casting, Injection Molding, or Stamping Industries is preferred.
Howmet Aerospace , is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. The Company’s primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems and titanium structural parts necessary for mission-critical performance and efficiency in aerospace and defense applications, as well as forged wheels for commercial transportation. Howmet Aerospace is transforming the next phase of more fuel-efficient, quieter aerospace engines and sustainable ground transportation. For more information, visit  www.howmet.com . Follow @howmet: Twitter , Instagram , Facebook , LinkedIn and YouTube .

This position will be located in Whitehall, MI.
Job Roles
- Empowering talent --identifies and removes obstacles to productivity at individual and systemic levels; inspires and equips people to perform; understands direct link between people and measurable performance; provides cross-training opportunities.
- Flexibility --responds readily to a variety of stimuli in an environment where every day can be different; capable of multitasking and moving quickly from one topic to another; employs different mindsets or perspectives situationally.
- Organized and time conscious --manages time well; does what is needed efficiently; understands how long processes require and manages expectations; accordingly, navigates the tension between availability and proactivity.
- Business-minded --aligns people and resources to demand; forecasts need and synthesizes input to anticipate focus areas on a time and project basis; thorough understanding of business enables quick decisions where appropriate.
- Interpretation and synthesis --makes sense of multiple inputs quickly and efficiently; generates action plans from available information; interprets data and qualitative information to provide justification and purpose; rationalizes decision making with substantive reasoning; understands relevant numbers and trends.
- Rigor --participates in audit processes; utilizes existing systems extensively and expertly; solicits information from shift level to enterprise; creates processes through continuous improvement.
- Team orientation --often involved at a tactical level; can contribute technically or operationally if needed, though not as first option; retains authority while delegating ownership.
- Trust and relationship --communicates openly and regularly, maintaining information flow; visible on floor; focuses attention on strengths and achievements, while addressing shortcomings as needed.
- Ingenuity --finds efficiencies and gains time closer to delivery; solicits and implements ideas; invites improvement from any sector or level.
- Professional posture --handles escalations objectively and dispassionately; recasts difficult situations as opportunities for learning and growth; custodian of plant environment and brand.

Job Responsibilities
This is a staff level position responsible for providing leadership in manufacturing excellence, ensuring customer satisfaction and continuous improvement of plant performance measurements (quality, productivity, cycle time, delivery, and cash flow).
- Follow Safety Regulations along with all department specific safety requirements.
- OEE
- Production Value Added by department.
- Daily targets for shipments
- Profit/Revenue
- Ensure the safety of all employees by promoting a clean and safe work environment.
- Improve manufacturing planning, execution, and shop floor discipline.
- Provide leadership for Plant ABS and lean manufacturing initiatives.
- Provide leadership to identify and remove non-value-added waste.
- Improve product flow and/or implement method improvements to reduce labor content.
- Develop and train for the professional and personal growth of team leaders, cell facilitators, supervisors, and other manufacturing support personnel.
- Address any safety issues or non-compliances immediately.
- Promote Injury Free Event (IFE) reporting.
- Accountable for applicable department budgets.
- Maintain good relations and communication with Howmet customers.
- Develop with plant manager and staff budget, strategic plans, team goals and objectives that align with BU objectives.
- Flow down goals and objectives to the entire organization.
- Contribute to other location specific and corporate teams.
- Maintain excellent delivery performance.
- Conduct capacity analysis to drive standard work and ensure accuracy of standards.
- Drive cost reductions to improve profitability.
- Use lean manufacturing tools to reduce WIP and cycle time.
- Communicate all relevant information to Staff, customers, and management.
- Understand constraint management, OEE and apply techniques that exploit constraints to improve OEE.
- Provide leadership in implementing continuous improvement methods and ideas.
- Consults with engineering personnel relative to modifications to the process to improve production and quality of the products.
- Provide leadership in a safety and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement, Capital Projects and Infracstructure
jobs.description:
Education:
- A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations required.
- MBA preferred.

Experience and Background:
- 5+ years of experience managing CAPEX projects in manufacturing environments.
- Experience supporting real estate and facilities strategy, including lease management, site utilization, and broker engagement.
- Must have excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- Familiarity with AS9100, FAA regulations, and defense compliance.
- Strong knowledge of aerospace, fasteners, or precision manufacturing industries.
- Must be able to prioritize and complete multiple and diverse work assignments with minimal direction and supervision.
Responsibilities
Howmet Fastening Systems (HFS) is seeking a Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement, Capital Projects and Infrastructure based at our Torrance, California Headquarters, or an alternate Southern California site, with regular travel to sites. We hold the number one global position in aerospace fastening systems, and we’re the North American leader in commercial transportation fasteners. Our high-tech, multi-material fastening systems are found nose to tail on aircraft and aerospace engines. Our products are also critical components of industrial gas turbines, automobiles, commercial transportation vehicles, and construction and industrial equipment.
General Summary:
We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement, Capital Projects and Infrastructure to lead and deliver Cost Savings and CAPEX initiatives across our HFS North America Aerospace (NA Aero) manufacturing sites. This role is pivotal in driving operational efficiency, innovation, and growth through the successful execution of capital investments—on time, within budget, and aligned with ROI/payback expectations. You will manage a dynamic portfolio of infrastructure, equipment, and technology projects, ensuring alignment with long-term asset value and strategic goals.
This role will serve as the primary leader for the NA Aero Continuous Improvement Program (CIP), driving $20m+ in year-over-year productivity, waste reduction, and operational excellence. The leader will oversee CI governance, track savings delivery against annual targets and ensure strong engagement and accountability from plant leadership teams.
The leader will also play a key role in shaping future investments by partnering with operational and cross-functional leaders to identify and scope opportunities that enhance our capabilities in aerospace, fasteners, and precision manufacturing. The scope of this role also includes responsibility for our real estate and footprint strategy, such as engaging with brokers to manage leases and renewals, and supporting sites with utilization and expansion needs. Furthermore, you will oversee the forecasting and tracking of greenhouse gas (GHG) reduction targets and actuals, ensuring capital investments are aligned with environmental impact goals and sustainability commitments. All projects must meet safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, and contribute meaningfully to our competitive positioning.
Specific Responsibilities:
- Lead full lifecycle delivery of capital projects across North America, from concept and feasibility through design, procurement, installation, and commissioning, while ensuring disciplined execution of scope, schedule, budget, and vendor performance.
- Provide strong financial and governance oversight for CAPEX initiatives, including cost tracking, forecasting, variance analysis, and alignment with annual plans and approval requirements.
- Drive continuous improvement in capital investment, identifying new opportunities with site leaders, optimizing spend, reducing waste, improving ROI, and strengthening long‑term asset value and operational efficiency.
- Partner cross-functionally with operations, engineering, finance, procurement, and EHS to align project objectives with broader enterprise strategy.
- Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation including budgets, schedules, risk assessments, and ROI/payback analyses. Identify potential risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful project outcomes.
- Lead the NA Aero Continuous Improvement Program (CIP), including annual goal‑setting, project pipeline development, and delivery of major productivity and cost‑reduction targets across all sites.
- Drive CI engagement and accountability with plant leadership, provide Lean and problem‑solving coaching, and ensure each site maintains a prioritized portfolio of improvement initiatives.
- Consolidate and validate CI results, report savings and operational impact to senior leadership, and integrate CI priorities with CAPEX strategies to strengthen long‑term performance.
- Oversee contractor selection and bid processes while managing vendors throughout construction and installation to ensure quality, cost‑effectiveness, and adherence to project specifications, timelines, and governance requirements
- Oversee real estate and footprint strategy of manufacturing sites, including lease management, broker engagement, and support for site utilization and expansion planning.
- Lead forecasting and tracking of greenhouse gas (GHG) reduction targets and actuals, ensuring capital investments align with sustainability goals and environmental impact objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, environmental, and regulatory standards throughout each phase of the project lifecycle.
- Champion continuous improvement in project execution methodologies, governance practices, and investment strategies.

Skills:
- Extensive knowledge and experience with lean manufacturing. Must have proven leadership and management skills. Thorough knowledge of complex electronic business enterprise systems required.
- Demonstrated experience leading multi-site Continuous Improvement programs, including savings tracking, CI Governance, and deployment of Lean tools
- Proven success delivering single-site and multi-site capital projects with budgets ranging from $500k to $50M.
- Familiarity with sustainability metrics and GHG emissions tracking; ability to align capital investments with environmental performance goals.
- Ability to work effectively with employees, peers, senior-level leaders, customers and vendor representatives.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and persuasion skills. Ability to work independently, prioritizing and completing multiple work assignments in diverse fields with minimal direction.
- The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of incumbents in this job classification.

Benefits/Salary:
- The position includes competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance (medical, dental, vision), excellent 401(k) matching program, paid holidays and vacation. The salary range for this position is $170,000-210,000 annually.

jobs.description:

- Experience : Minimum 5 years of broad supply chain or multi-site purchasing experience, with at least 3 years in a direct team-management capacity.     Experience with Aerospace Engineered Components (castings, machined, stamped components)
- Systems Expertise : High proficiency navigating enterprise ERP software ecosystems alongside modern e-procurement platforms.
- Core Competencies : Exceptional financial acumen, advanced multi-party commercial negotiation skills, and a clear history of workflow optimization.
- Travel : Ability to travel up to 35% to various regional sites and vendor facilities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced Degree : Master of Business Administration (MBA) or an advanced degree in Supply Chain Architecture.
- Certifications : Industry-recognized designations such as CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management) or CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional).

Compensation: 155k - 185k
The Senior Procurement Operations Manager, Engineered Products oversees the execution, compliance, and optimization of end-to-end purchasing activities across NA Engineered Products regional locations. This role bridges corporate procurement strategy with regional site execution, driving process automation, supply continuity, and cost-control discipline. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader focused on operational excellence, data-driven performance management, and building robust regional and local vendor partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Execution & Support
- Align local purchasing strategy and day to day tactical management with corporate standard operating procedures and global category strategies.
- Source and Manage a successful supply base for complex mechanical commodities —such as castings, precision machined aerospace alloys, stamped parts, etc.
- Drive performance in key areas:  Cost savings, Inflation mitigation and management, on time delivery performance, inventory optimization, supplier payment terms, and supplier risk mitigation.
- Provide frontline support to local procurement teams for order forecasting, sourcing bottlenecks, and critical vendor disputes.
- Manage business continuity by executing regional risk-mitigation plans against single sourced-supplier issues and market shortages.
